channel.title: Github-Actions | AI Engineering
channel.description: A 23-chapter handbook for Claude Code — permissions, context, skills, hooks, MCP and agents, worked out end to end for engineers who have to ship with it.

item.title: GitHub, GitLab & CI
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Three levels of integration, from Claude running git for you to Claude as a CI step. The @claude bot, the two modes a workflow can run in, and what a headless run does with permissions when nobody is there to answer.
